title: Innocuous-Seeming Data, Latent Ideology: Ideological Generalisation in Finetuned LLMs
reasoning: The paper includes 'Moral Foundations' and 'Religion & spirituality' as specific cross-domain evaluation categories to measure how finetuning shifts an LLM's ideological and belief systems. It also explicitly tests model responses on topics such as Islam, Jewish people, and societal values.
